slideDifferences.nativeText:
To Consider 
1. Some verbs only admit other verbs in infinitive.
2. Some verbs only admit other verbs in gerunds.  
3.  Other verbs work with both, infinitive and gerunds.
4. Gerunds can be found after prepositions too.
5. Infinitive can be found after adjectives too.
6. We can also find infinitives after nouns. E.G. I had the chance to tell her.

slideDifferences.nativeText:
B. Listen to the audio and answer the questions your teacher makes.
How to be in life

I am sure there are many conceptions on how to proceed in life regarding many issues. Fairly speaking, I believe people need to be honest to get along with others. Additionally, by respecting others, you can get to be respected as well. People have to understand that respect and honesty are fundamental to have and keep healthy relationships in life. I have decided to live by these standards and it would be a great idea for people to consider them, and have the courage to admit not having used these values in certain circumstances in order to say they’re sorry and mend what they did. 

What do you think of this? Do you agree?

texts: There are some aspects that we can cover when using gerunds and infinitives.
I think it is important to have another meeting.
We need to avoid arguments and start finding solutions.
I am going to stop playing funny business.

Let’s keep playing some more.
Hmmm… What if we start to prepare the burgers instead.

paragraphs.text: I am sure there are many conceptions on how to proceed in life regarding many issues. Fairly speaking, I believe people need to be honest to get along with others. Additionally, by respecting others, you can get to be respected as well. People have to understand that respect and honesty are fundamental to have and keep healthy relationships in life. I have decided to live by these standards and it would be a great idea for people to consider them, and have the courage to admit not having used these values in certain circumstances in order to say they’re sorry and mend what they did.
